13.4.1 Default Error Tracer Service use Case: report failure
[TPS_BSWMDT_04152] Setup for Default Error Tracer Service use Case: report failure: ⌈Scenario: a Basic Software Module reports a failure to the Default Error Tracer. In this case the following setup apply: ServiceNeeds kind ErrorTracerNeeds RoleBasedBswModuleEntryAssignment valid roles:
• Det_ReportError [0..1]
• Det_ReportRuntimeError [0..1]
• Det_ReportTransientFault [0..1] RoleBasedDataAssignment N/A RoleBasedDataTypeAssignment N/A
⌋()
